prompt: The museums' collections (departments) as framed tiles with a real cover work, grouped by museum on /collections or shown as a short teaser rail elsewhere. Loads its own data.
shortDesc: The museums' collections (departments) as tiles with a real cover work, each linking to /collections/<id>. It loads them itself (don't wrap it in g-grid, and put it inside a g-page-section for its heading). Use it on /collections with no attributes (grouped by museum automatically, sorted by name), and as a teaser with limit and layout="rail" on the home page (e.g. limit="10" layout="rail") and on /collections/<id> (there add exclude="<that id>"; a single excluded id also limits the list to that id's museum, e.g. <g-collection-list exclude="met-11" limit="8" layout="rail">). A rail or limited teaser with nothing to show hides itself and its g-page-section. All instances share one request, so several on a page cost nothing extra.

props.name: museum
props.description: aic, met or both; any other value means both. Filtered on the client by the id prefix. When omitted, a single exclude id sets it to that id's museum (otherwise both).

props.name: exclude
props.description: A collection id to leave out, e.g. the current page's met-11 (comma-separated ids also work). A single id with no museum attribute also shows only that id's museum.

props.name: limit
props.description: Show at most this many tiles, e.g. limit="8" (default all). With a limit the two museums alternate, with no group headings, and collections with a cover image come first.

props.name: layout
props.description: grid (default) or rail (one horizontally scrolling row with previous/next buttons; ideal for teasers).

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(240px,100%),1fr))] gap-6; rail: flex gap-5 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory [&>*]:w-[220px] [&>*]:shrink-0
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. Grouped view: each museum headed by an h3 oxblood small-caps kicker, a hairline rule, and a soft 'n collections' count; groups 44px apart. Rail: scroll-snap row of 220px (240px from 860px) tiles, a hairline track with a gilt position thumb, and 44px square previous/next buttons (hidden when nothing overflows); arrow keys move focus tile to tile and scroll it into view; 10px/8px inner padding so focus rings are not clipped. Loading: 6 mat-coloured skeleton tiles (4:3 frame plus two lines) with a 1.6s pulse. Empty: a rail or limited teaser hides itself and its g-page-section; the full view shows italic serif 'No collections available right now.' A requested museum returning no departments counts as a load failure: .error 'Couldn't load the collections of <museum> right now.' with a ghost 'Try again' (below the other museum's group in the grouped view). Error: .error text with a ghost 'Try again' button. Reduced motion disables smooth scrolling and pulses.

dependencies.usage: One tile per department: collection-id=id, name, museum, image-url=coverImageUrl (a /__art/ URL, or empty for the typographic placeholder).

interactions.trigger: component mounts (shared by every instance on the page)
interactions.bodyShape: READS.collections(): { intent: 'list museum collections (ListDepartments)', museum: 'both', outputFormat: { departments: [{ id, museum, name, coverImageUrl }] } }
